thesis: 7-Eleven plans to close 645 North American stores in fiscal 2026—its fifth consecutive year closing more locations than opening—while parent Seven & i Holdings projects 9.4% revenue decline amid declining foot traffic, franchisee disputes, and structural industry headwinds in convenience retail.

facts.claim: 7-Eleven will close 645 North American stores in fiscal 2026 (March 2026–Feb 2027), more than triple the 205 planned openings.
Seven & i Holdings parent company expects 9.4% revenue decline, approximately $59.5 billion in losses, for current fiscal year.
7-Eleven fiscal 2026 closure announcement marks fifth consecutive year chain closed more stores than it opened.
U.S. 7-Eleven locations faced declining foot traffic, revenue, and franchisee disputes with hundreds shuttered in past two years.
Convenience store industry shifting revenue away from cigarettes toward foodservice (30% of in-store revenue by 2024, up from 12% in 2004).
7-Eleven closures part of broader effort to evolve business model toward higher-margin foodservice offerings and away from traditional convenience model.
